sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: Downtown Oakland, where we work, is beautiful.
sentences.zh: 我们工作的奥克兰市中心非常美丽。

sentences.en: But it doesn't cut a very distinct skyline.
sentences.zh: 但它的天际线并不算特别鲜明。

sentences.en: Sure, there are the cranes down by the port, and those are pretty famous.
sentences.zh: 当然，港口那边有起重机，那些还挺出名的。

sentences.en: But in terms of downtown Oakland proper,
sentences.zh: 但就奥克兰市中心本身而言，

sentences.en: there's pretty much just one building that defines the nighttime skyline.
sentences.zh: 几乎只有一栋建筑定义了这里的夜间天际线。

sentences.en: The Tribune Tower.
sentences.zh: 论坛报大厦。

sentences.en: It used to be the headquarters of the newspaper, the Oakland Tribune.
sentences.zh: 它曾经是《奥克兰论坛报》的总部。

sentences.en: The paper moved up the street, so now the tower is an office building.
sentences.zh: 报社搬到了街上，所以现在这栋大厦是一栋办公楼。

sentences.en: That's producer Avery Truffleman.
sentences.zh: 那是制片人艾弗里·特鲁夫曼。

sentences.en: The Tribune Tower, which happens to be right by our office,
sentences.zh: 论坛报大厦恰好就在我们办公室旁边，

sentences.en: was the tallest building in Oakland in the 1920s.
sentences.zh: 是20世纪20年代奥克兰最高的建筑。

sentences.en: It's a 22-story tower, topped with a copper-coated,
sentences.zh: 这是一栋22层的大厦，顶部覆盖着铜皮，

sentences.en: pitched mansard roof and a sandy brick exterior.
sentences.zh: 有着坡度陡峭的孟莎式屋顶和沙色的砖墙外观。

sentences.en: It's really unique architecture,
sentences.zh: 它的建筑风格确实很独特，

sentences.en: but that is not why it's the most distinctive building in Oakland.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是它成为奥克兰最独特建筑的原因。

sentences.en: It's famous because it says Tribune in gigantic orange-red neon letters
sentences.zh: 它之所以出名，是因为大厦的四个侧面

sentences.en: on all four sides of the building,
sentences.zh: 都用巨大的橙红色霓虹灯写着“论坛报”三个字，

sentences.en: and each side has a neon clock with neon hands.
sentences.zh: 而且每一面都有一个带霓虹灯指针的霓虹时钟。

sentences.en: And it's always on, every night, never flickering, rarely is a letter out.
sentences.zh: 它总是亮着，每天晚上，从不闪烁，也很少有字母熄灭。

sentences.en: Because the Tribune neon has a secret weapon on the top, top floor of the tower.
sentences.zh: 因为论坛报的霓虹灯在大厦的最顶层藏着一件秘密武器。

sentences.en: Take the elevator to the 20th floor.
sentences.zh: 乘电梯到20楼。

sentences.en: There, you'll see a door.
sentences.zh: 在那里，你会看到一扇门。

sentences.en: Restricted area, limited access.
sentences.zh: 限制区域，禁止入内。

sentences.en: And there's a flight of narrow stairs.
sentences.zh: 还有一段狭窄的楼梯。

sentences.en: Up the stairs, you'll find a man.
sentences.zh: 顺着楼梯上去，你会发现一个人。

sentences.en: John?
sentences.zh: 约翰？

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Hey there.
sentences.zh: 嘿。

sentences.en: John Law, the keeper of the neon.
sentences.zh: 约翰·劳，霓虹灯的守护者。

sentences.en: We are on the 22nd floor of the Oakland Tribune Tower.
sentences.zh: 我们现在在奥克兰论坛报大厦的22楼。

sentences.en: So I have a tiny office space in one corner,
sentences.zh: 我在角落里有一个小小的办公空间，

sentences.en: and the current owners, I have a wonderful arrangement with them,
sentences.zh: 现在的业主和我达成了一个很棒的协议，

sentences.en: and, you know, we rent the place from them,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们从他们那里租下这个地方，

sentences.en: and I'll keep their neon signs going.
sentences.zh: 而我负责维护他们的霓虹灯。

sentences.en: By trade, John Law is a sign installer and maintainer,
sentences.zh: 约翰·劳的职业是霓虹灯安装和维护人员，

sentences.en: and he is the one that keeps the Tribune Tower neon blazing.
sentences.zh: 正是他让论坛报大厦的霓虹灯始终闪耀。

sentences.en: Nowadays, a wraparound neon clock on the 20th floor of a building is fairly rare.
sentences.zh: 如今，在建筑20楼安装环绕式霓虹时钟已经相当罕见。

sentences.en: There were more in the 30s and 40s.
sentences.zh: 在30和40年代，这种时钟更多。

sentences.en: They built a lot more buildings with signage on them and neon on them.
sentences.zh: 那时他们建造了更多带有标识和霓虹灯的建筑。

sentences.en: They're almost all gone.
sentences.zh: 现在几乎都消失了。

sentences.en: The Tribune neon, like many, many neon signs,
sentences.zh: 论坛报的霓虹灯，像许多许多霓虹灯一样，

sentences.en: has had periods of darkness and neglect.
sentences.zh: 也经历过黑暗和被忽视的时期。

sentences.en: Most signs of this size have been allowed to flicker out and die.
sentences.zh: 大多数这种规模的招牌都被任由其闪烁熄灭直至报废。

sentences.en: But thanks to John and the owner of the tower,
sentences.zh: 但多亏了约翰和这栋大厦的业主，

sentences.en: the Tribune neon, after a period of neglect,
sentences.zh: 论坛报的霓虹灯在经历了一段被忽视的时期后，

sentences.en: has been on consistently since the late 90s.
sentences.zh: 自90年代末以来一直保持着常亮。

sentences.en: And this is no small feat.
sentences.zh: 这可不是一件容易的事。

sentences.en: This is back of one of the four clocks.
sentences.zh: 这是四个时钟其中一个的背面。

sentences.en: Watch your head.
sentences.zh: 小心你的头。

sentences.en: John can repair some of the neon from within the tower.
sentences.zh: 约翰可以在大厦内部修理部分霓虹灯。

sentences.en: But if I have to get out on the face and work on the neon on the letters,
sentences.zh: 但如果我必须到外面去修理字母上的霓虹灯，

sentences.en: I have to clip into it.
sentences.zh: 我就得把自己扣在上面。

sentences.en: I have a full-body harness and kind of step onto the face of the letter
sentences.zh: 我穿着全身式安全带，踏上字母的表面，

sentences.en: with my butt hanging over a drop.
sentences.zh: 屁股下面就是悬空。

sentences.en: A drop of something like 300 feet.
sentences.zh: 大约300英尺的落差。

sentences.en: But John loves heights.
sentences.zh: 但约翰热爱高空。

sentences.en: And he loves neon.
sentences.zh: 他也热爱霓虹灯。

sentences.en: There's nothing like neon.
sentences.zh: 没有什么能比得上霓虹灯。

sentences.en: I mean, other light sources,
sentences.zh: 我是说，其他的光源，

sentences.en: they don't have that kind of fuzzy, otherworldly look to it
sentences.zh: 它们没有那种霓虹灯特有的、

sentences.en: that you get with neon.
sentences.zh: 模糊而超凡脱俗的感觉。

sentences.en: And neon signage, you know, can be very beautiful.
sentences.zh: 而且你知道，霓虹灯招牌可以非常漂亮。

sentences.en: And a lot of people in the past have considered it to be cheesy and ugly
sentences.zh: 过去很多人认为它俗气、丑陋，

sentences.en: and representative of some dying commercialism that they found unpleasant.
sentences.zh: 代表着某种他们觉得令人不快的垂死商业主义。

sentences.en: People, like philosophers, essayists, writing critiques of late capitalism,
sentences.zh: 人们，比如哲学家、散文家，在撰写对晚期资本主义的批判时，

sentences.en: they use neon as a metaphor to express their distaste for the neon hell that we all live in.
sentences.zh: 他们用霓虹灯作为隐喻，来表达对我们所处的霓虹地狱的厌恶。

sentences.en: Christoph Ribat is the author of Flickering Light, A History of Neon.
sentences.zh: 克里斯托弗·里巴特是《闪烁之光：霓虹灯史》的作者。

sentences.en: And I teach American Studies at the University of Paderborn in Germany.
sentences.zh: 我在德国帕德博恩大学教授美国研究。

sentences.en: For Professor Ribat, to study neon is to study America.
sentences.zh: 对里巴特教授来说，研究霓虹灯就是研究美国。

sentences.en: A blinking in the night in some American diner,
sentences.zh: 美国餐馆里夜晚的闪烁，

sentences.en: that's just something, if you're coming from a European background,
sentences.zh: 如果你有欧洲背景，那确实是某种东西，

sentences.en: it has a really kind of aesthetic power to it.
sentences.zh: 它有一种真正的美学力量。

sentences.en: It is a great metaphor of American culture,
sentences.zh: 它是美国文化的一个伟大隐喻，

sentences.en: even though it's not an American product per se.
sentences.zh: 尽管它本身并非美国产品。

sentences.en: The gas, neon, was discovered in 1898 by a British scientist named Sir William Ramsey.
sentences.zh: 霓虹气体是1898年由一位名叫威廉·拉姆齐爵士的英国科学家发现的。

sentences.en: It was a new gas, so he named it for the Greek neos, meaning new.
sentences.zh: 这是一种新气体，所以他以希腊语“neos”命名，意为“新”。

sentences.en: Ramsey realized that if he ran electricity through this new gas,
sentences.zh: 拉姆齐意识到，如果他让电流通过这种新气体，

sentences.en: it would burn bright, bright orangey red.
sentences.zh: 它会发出明亮、耀眼的橙红色光芒。

sentences.en: But he basically said, oh, that's cool, and then forgot about it,
sentences.zh: 但他基本上只是说，哦，那很酷，然后就把它忘了，

sentences.en: moving on to find other gases and ultimately win a Nobel Prize.
sentences.zh: 转而去寻找其他气体，并最终获得了诺贝尔奖。

sentences.en: But neon lights as we know them were made and popularized by another chemiSt.
sentences.zh: 但我们所知的霓虹灯是由另一位化学家制造并推广的。

sentences.en: It was this Frenchman, and he, like, played around with these neon tubes.
sentences.zh: 那是一个法国人，他摆弄着这些霓虹灯管。

sentences.en: And he was a pretty good businessman and thought, well, we could do something with this.
sentences.zh: 他是个相当精明的商人，心想，嗯，我们可以用这个做点什么。

sentences.en: A Frenchman named Georges Claude made his first neon lights in 1910,
sentences.zh: 一位名叫乔治·克劳德的法国人在1910年制造了他的第一批霓虹灯，

sentences.en: and he eventually quit chemistry to start a business called Claude Neon.
sentences.zh: 他最终放弃了化学，创办了一家名为“克劳德霓虹”的公司。

sentences.en: It was the first to sell this new lighting for decor and for advertising.
sentences.zh: 这是第一家销售这种用于装饰和广告的新型照明设备的公司。

sentences.en: The first neon signs were up in Paris.
sentences.zh: 第一批霓虹灯招牌出现在巴黎。

sentences.en: The barber shop was the first shop ever to have a neon sign.
sentences.zh: 理发店是第一家拥有霓虹灯招牌的商店。

sentences.en: And then it really spread around the city of Paris.
sentences.zh: 然后它真的在巴黎全城传播开来。

sentences.en: And from Paris, then it spread around the world.
sentences.zh: 从巴黎开始，它又传遍了全世界。

sentences.en: Georges Claude may have been the father of neon lights, but he was not a good guy.
sentences.zh: 乔治·克劳德可能是霓虹灯之父，但他并不是个好人。

sentences.en: Well, yeah, you know, it's hard to fall in love with him.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是的，你知道，很难对他产生好感。

sentences.en: He turned into an ardent follower of Nazi Germany.
sentences.zh: 他变成了纳粹德国的狂热追随者。

sentences.en: You know, great businessman, but also doubtful morals.
sentences.zh: 你知道，伟大的商人，但道德上令人怀疑。

sentences.en: But neon swept the United States.
sentences.zh: 但霓虹灯席卷了美国。

sentences.en: It was brighter and more efficient than incandescent lighting,
sentences.zh: 它比白炽灯更亮、效率更高，

sentences.en: and Americans were giddy with it.
sentences.zh: 美国人对它感到欣喜若狂。

sentences.en: By 1924, the company Claude Neon had franchises in 14 major cities across the country.
sentences.zh: 到1924年，克劳德霓虹公司在全国14个主要城市拥有特许经营权。

sentences.en: By the 1930s, there were 20,000 neon advertisements in Manhattan and Brooklyn,
sentences.zh: 到20世纪30年代，曼哈顿和布鲁克林有2万个霓虹灯广告，

sentences.en: most of them made by Claude Neon.
sentences.zh: 其中大部分由克劳德霓虹公司制造。

sentences.en: Neon signs were the embodiment of prosperity.
sentences.zh: 霓虹灯招牌是繁荣的化身。

sentences.en: So neon was on respectable, upscale spots like movie palace marquees and opera houses.
sentences.zh: 所以霓虹灯出现在电影院大门和歌剧院等体面、高档的地方。

sentences.en: You know, nice places.
sentences.zh: 你知道，不错的地方。

sentences.en: So it started with the churches and the fur stores and the car dealerships, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以它始于教堂、皮草店和汽车经销商，你知道，

sentences.en: institutions that signified luxury.
sentences.zh: 那些象征奢侈的机构。

sentences.en: Neon became the symbol of life in the big city.
sentences.zh: 霓虹灯成为了大城市生活的象征。

sentences.en: Late 40s, Peggy Lee, a singer in those days, she had a song.
sentences.zh: 40年代末，当时的歌手佩吉·李有一首歌。

sentences.en: I'm going out where the neon signs shine down on the avenue.
sentences.zh: 我要去霓虹灯照耀的大道上。

sentences.en: I'm going out with the neon signs, and I'm going to shine like neon blue.
sentences.zh: 我要去霓虹灯下，我要像霓虹蓝一样闪耀。

sentences.en: It was really this neon enthusiasm of that period.
sentences.zh: 那确实是那个时期对霓虹灯的热情。

sentences.en: But the initial excitement fades.
sentences.zh: 但最初的兴奋感逐渐消退。

sentences.en: The popularity of downtown wanes.
sentences.zh: 市中心的受欢迎程度下降了。

sentences.en: People move to the suburbs.
sentences.zh: 人们搬到了郊区。

sentences.en: The cities grow dark.
sentences.zh: 城市变得黑暗。

sentences.en: The neon flickers.
sentences.zh: 霓虹灯开始闪烁。

sentences.en: Years later, 10, 20 years down the road,
sentences.zh: 多年以后，10年、20年后，

sentences.en: then it was like more cheap bars, cheap hotels,
sentences.zh: 它更多地出现在廉价酒吧、廉价旅馆里，

sentences.en: and then it had this seedy quality to it.
sentences.zh: 于是它带上了一种肮脏的特质。

sentences.en: And then by and by, it turned into this metaphor of people who,
sentences.zh: 渐渐地，它变成了那些人的隐喻，

sentences.en: you know, more or less critiqued the loneliness in society.
sentences.zh: 你知道，或多或少批判了社会中的孤独感。

sentences.en: There's a lot of country and western songs that are, you know,
sentences.zh: 有很多乡村音乐歌曲，你知道，

sentences.en: always have someone, you know, getting drunk by the neon sign.
sentences.zh: 总是有人在霓虹灯下喝得酩酊大醉。

sentences.en: And suddenly neon, which used to be a sign of luxury,
sentences.zh: 突然间，曾经作为奢华标志的霓虹灯，

sentences.en: turns into a symbol of poverty and of run-down cities.
sentences.zh: 变成了贫困和破败城市的象征。

sentences.en: Neon is also hard to maintain,
sentences.zh: 霓虹灯也很难维护，

sentences.en: and a broken neon sign is a bright, flashing sign of brokenness.
sentences.zh: 而一个坏掉的霓虹灯招牌，就是一个明亮、闪烁的破碎标志。

sentences.en: And that's why it became the symbol of decay.
sentences.zh: 这就是它成为衰败象征的原因。

sentences.en: If neon tubes are made well, they can last about 30 years,
sentences.zh: 如果霓虹灯管制作精良，它们可以使用大约30年，

sentences.en: sometimes up to 70.
sentences.zh: 有时甚至长达70年。

sentences.en: But they are glass, so they can break.
sentences.zh: 但它们是玻璃做的，所以可能会碎。

sentences.en: And they're out there in the elements,
sentences.zh: 而且它们暴露在自然环境中，

sentences.en: so the electricity can flicker out.
sentences.zh: 所以电流可能会闪烁熄灭。

sentences.en: When a neon sign goes out,
sentences.zh: 当霓虹灯熄灭时，

sentences.en: you can't just screw in a new tube or order up a cheap replacement.
sentences.zh: 你不能只是拧上一个新灯管或订购一个廉价的替代品。

sentences.en: You would think that it was like a machine-made product, right?
sentences.zh: 你可能会认为它像机器制造的产品，对吧？

sentences.en: That there was some sort of big neon factory
sentences.zh: 认为有什么大型霓虹灯工厂，

sentences.en: that just turned out neon on an assembly line.
sentences.zh: 在流水线上生产霓虹灯。

sentences.en: And that's really not the case.
sentences.zh: 但事实并非如此。

sentences.en: It's really craftsmen who shape these signs.
sentences.zh: 这真的是靠工匠来塑造这些招牌。

sentences.en: They bend the tubes with their hands.
sentences.zh: 他们用双手弯曲灯管。

sentences.en: It's really just, you know, one person doing this.
sentences.zh: 这真的只是，你知道，一个人在做这件事。

sentences.en: A person like Shawna Peterson.
sentences.zh: 像肖娜·彼得森这样的人。

sentences.en: A neon glassblower is not a glassblower.
sentences.zh: 霓虹灯吹制工不是玻璃吹制工。

sentences.en: It's really called neon tube bending.
sentences.zh: 这实际上被称为霓虹灯管弯制。

sentences.en: That's the trade.
sentences.zh: 这就是这门手艺。

sentences.en: We're tube benders.
sentences.zh: 我们是灯管弯制工。

sentences.en: Shawna Peterson has been bending since 1987.
sentences.zh: 肖娜·彼得森从1987年就开始做弯制了。

sentences.en: She says color is a good way to decode these signs,
sentences.zh: 她说颜色是解读这些招牌的好方法，

sentences.en: to know what's inside of them and what quality they are.
sentences.zh: 了解它们内部的构造以及它们的质量。

sentences.en: Red neon lights are the most basic and the most popular.
sentences.zh: 红色霓虹灯是最基础也是最受欢迎的。

sentences.en: And that's like a reddish-orange.
sentences.zh: 那看起来就像是一种红橙色。

sentences.en: And that's the standard neon red.
sentences.zh: 那就是标准的霓虹红。

sentences.en: That is pure neon gas.
sentences.zh: 那是纯霓虹气体。

sentences.en: It just naturally burns that color.
sentences.zh: 它自然而然就会发出那种颜色的光。

sentences.en: And then there's blue neon, also pretty basic.
sentences.zh: 还有蓝色霓虹灯，也相当基础。

sentences.en: The cool secret about blue neon is that it's not actually neon gas.
sentences.zh: 关于蓝色霓虹灯的一个酷炫秘密是，它实际上并不是霓虹气体。

sentences.en: It's argon gas, brightened with a little mercury.
sentences.zh: 它是氩气，用少量汞增亮。

sentences.en: But we still call them neon signs.
sentences.zh: 但我们仍然称它们为霓虹灯招牌。

sentences.en: And for a while, almost all neon signs were just red and blue.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，几乎所有的霓虹灯招牌都只有红色和蓝色。

sentences.en: Pure neon or argon mercury in clear tubes.
sentences.zh: 透明灯管里的纯霓虹气体或氩汞混合气体。

sentences.en: Then the industry came up with a way to make any color you want.
sentences.zh: 后来行业想出了一种方法，可以做出你想要的任何颜色。

sentences.en: There's a phosphor powder coating on the inside of the tubes.
sentences.zh: 灯管内部涂有一层荧光粉涂层。

sentences.en: Benders can use tubes with different phosphors on the inside of the tubes
sentences.zh: 灯管弯制工可以使用内部涂有不同荧光粉的灯管

sentences.en: to create more colors than just red and blue.
sentences.zh: 来创造出比红色和蓝色更多的颜色。

sentences.en: Use a fuchsia, use a green, a lime green.
sentences.zh: 用紫红色、绿色、青柠绿。

sentences.en: Go for a lime green, you know.
sentences.zh: 选个青柠绿，你知道的。

sentences.en: Use of color done well is nice.
sentences.zh: 颜色运用得当会很漂亮。

sentences.en: Now, just to be clear, those neon beer signs at the bodega,
sentences.zh: 现在，要说明的是，那些小杂货店里的霓虹啤酒招牌，

sentences.en: or those standard open signs, can be, and often are,
sentences.zh: 或者那些标准的“营业中”招牌，可以而且通常是

sentences.en: made on a massive scale in China.
sentences.zh: 在中国大规模生产的。

sentences.en: Those are still hand-blown.
sentences.zh: 那些仍然是手工吹制的。

sentences.en: That's the only way to make neon.
sentences.zh: 那是制作霓虹灯的唯一方法。

sentences.en: But that's like one person makes only the letter E all day long.
sentences.zh: 但这就像是一个人整天只做字母E。

sentences.en: Another person makes only O's.
sentences.zh: 另一个人只做O。

sentences.en: And these signs are lower quality.
sentences.zh: 而且这些招牌质量较低。

sentences.en: Cheap signs for beer brands or generic open signs
sentences.zh: 用于啤酒品牌的廉价招牌或通用的“营业中”招牌

sentences.en: are often colored with a coating of colored plastic
sentences.zh: 通常是用一层彩色塑料涂层来着色

sentences.en: on the outside of the glass tubes.
sentences.zh: 在玻璃管的外部。

sentences.en: Usually it's so cheap you can chip it off with your fingernail.
sentences.zh: 通常它非常廉价，你用指甲就能把它刮掉。

sentences.en: But if you're looking at a sign over your local bar or hotel,
sentences.zh: 但如果你看到当地酒吧或酒店上方的招牌，

sentences.en: or sometimes even a neon sign over a chain store,
sentences.zh: 或者有时甚至是连锁店上方的霓虹灯招牌，

sentences.en: if it's large and you haven't seen it anywhere else,
sentences.zh: 如果它很大，而且你在其他地方没见过，

sentences.en: it was probably painstakingly crafted.
sentences.zh: 那它很可能是精心制作的。

sentences.en: Probably locally.
sentences.zh: 很可能是在当地制作的。

sentences.en: Neon tube benders get glass from the manufacturer
sentences.zh: 霓虹灯管弯制工从制造商那里获得玻璃，

sentences.en: in four-foot-long tubes.
sentences.zh: 以四英尺长的管子形式。

sentences.en: And they draw out a pattern for how they'll bend and fuse it.
sentences.zh: 他们会画出一个图案，决定如何弯曲和熔接它。

sentences.en: When you're bending the word apple, you never start with A.
sentences.zh: 当你弯制“apple”这个词时，你永远不会从A开始。

sentences.en: You have to map out in your mind where those curves are
sentences.zh: 你必须在脑海中规划出那些曲线在哪里，

sentences.en: and how they're going to change direction.
sentences.zh: 以及它们将如何改变方向。

sentences.en: And generally, you're going to start somewhere in the center of that word
sentences.zh: 通常，你会从那个词的中心某处开始，

sentences.en: and work your way out.
sentences.zh: 然后向外延伸。

sentences.en: And Shauna has a number of different burners and tools
sentences.zh: Shauna有许多不同的燃烧器和工具

sentences.en: to manipulate the tubes.
sentences.zh: 来处理这些灯管。

sentences.en: To bend a curve, she'll hold the glass tube on either end
sentences.zh: 为了弯曲出一条曲线，她会握住玻璃管的两端，

sentences.en: over an open flame burner.
sentences.zh: 放在明火燃烧器上加热。

sentences.en: And when I'm using it, it sounds like this.
sentences.zh: 当我使用它时，听起来是这样的。

sentences.en: Shauna has only a few seconds to bend the glass into a perfect shape
sentences.zh: Shauna只有几秒钟的时间把玻璃弯成完美的形状，

sentences.en: before it hardens up again.
sentences.zh: 在它再次变硬之前。

sentences.en: So she has to act quickly and precisely.
sentences.zh: 所以她必须动作迅速且精确。

sentences.en: Sneezing is a tube-bender's nightmare.
sentences.zh: 打喷嚏是灯管弯制工的噩梦。

sentences.en: Then Shauna processes the bent tubes with a machine called a bombarder.
sentences.zh: 然后Shauna用一种叫轰击器的机器处理弯好的灯管。

sentences.en: It's this whole process where she heats up the tubes really, really hot
sentences.zh: 这是一个完整的过程，她把灯管加热得非常非常热，

sentences.en: and vacuums out the impurities before filling the tubes with neon or argon mercury
sentences.zh: 并在注入霓虹气体或氩汞气体之前抽走杂质，

sentences.en: and fuses the electrical source to them.
sentences.zh: 然后将电源熔接到它们上面。

sentences.en: That, in crude summary, is the craft.
sentences.zh: 粗略总结一下，这就是这门手艺。

sentences.en: It's expensive, it's difficult,
sentences.zh: 它很昂贵，很困难，

sentences.en: and there aren't that many people who can make neon signs.
sentences.zh: 而且没有多少人能制作霓虹灯招牌。

sentences.en: And that is why...
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么……

sentences.en: When they break, they usually get replaced with LEDs.
sentences.zh: 当它们坏掉时，通常会被LED取代。

sentences.en: LED is so much cheaper.
sentences.zh: LED便宜得多。

sentences.en: And people in the LED industry will tell you it's so much brighter as well.
sentences.zh: LED行业的人会告诉你，它也亮得多。

sentences.en: Randall Ann Homan and Al Barna are the publishers and photographers
sentences.zh: Randall Ann Homan和Al Barna是

sentences.en: of a book called San Francisco Neon, Survivors and Lost Icons.
sentences.zh: 《旧金山霓虹：幸存者与失落的偶像》一书的出版商和摄影师。

sentences.en: All of these signs are part of our cultural heritage in San Francisco,
sentences.zh: 所有这些招牌都是我们旧金山文化遗产的一部分，

sentences.en: and they're treasures, and we need to hang on to them.
sentences.zh: 它们是宝藏，我们需要守护它们。

sentences.en: Randall and Al lead tours of some of their favorite neon around the city.
sentences.zh: Randall和Al会带领游客参观他们在城里最喜欢的一些霓虹灯。

sentences.en: Let's stop here.
sentences.zh: 我们在这里停一下。

sentences.en: Many of the signs are defunct,
sentences.zh: 许多招牌已经废弃，

sentences.en: or hang over businesses that they're no longer affiliated with.
sentences.zh: 或者悬挂在它们不再隶属的企业上方。

sentences.en: All right, so this is my very favorite sign.
sentences.zh: 好了，这是我最喜欢的招牌。

sentences.en: This Art Deco Peacock has no fewer than 17 concentric circles of neon,
sentences.zh: 这只装饰艺术风格的孔雀拥有不少于17个同心霓虹圆圈，

sentences.en: and it's really a feat of tube bending.
sentences.zh: 这确实是灯管弯制工艺的杰作。

sentences.en: Now, the business is long gone.
sentences.zh: 现在，那家企业早已不复存在了。

sentences.en: It's kind of a miracle that it's still here.
sentences.zh: 它还能留在这里简直是个奇迹。

sentences.en: San Francisco was once covered in neon.
sentences.zh: 旧金山曾经到处都是霓虹灯。

sentences.en: Look at an old picture of Market Street from the 1950s,
sentences.zh: 看看一张20世纪50年代市场街的老照片，

sentences.en: and you'll see it looks like the Vegas Strip,
sentences.zh: 你会发现它看起来就像拉斯维加斯大道，

sentences.en: all aglow with flashing lights.
sentences.zh: 到处闪烁着光芒。

sentences.en: Then, in the 60s, there was a campaign to get rid of all that flash
sentences.zh: 后来，在60年代，有一场运动旨在消除所有那些闪光，

sentences.en: and beautify that part of town,
sentences.zh: 美化城市的那一部分，

sentences.en: and almost all those neon signs were removed.
sentences.zh: 几乎所有的霓虹灯招牌都被拆除了。

sentences.en: And around the rest of the city, pretty regularly,
sentences.zh: 而在城市的其他地方，相当频繁地，

sentences.en: stops on Randall and Al's neon tour will just vanish.
sentences.zh: Randall和Al霓虹灯之旅的站点会直接消失。

sentences.en: It's embarrassing and awkward to bring a tour group around the corner
sentences.zh: 带着旅游团转过街角去谈论一个不再存在的招牌，

sentences.en: to talk about a sign that doesn't exist anymore,
sentences.zh: 这很尴尬也很别扭，

sentences.en: so it kind of illustrates the nature of neon signs.
sentences.zh: 所以这在某种程度上说明了霓虹灯招牌的本质。

sentences.en: If you're interested in photographing them or painting them,
sentences.zh: 如果你有兴趣拍摄或绘画它们，

sentences.en: do it as quick as you can, because they can disappear overnight.
sentences.zh: 请尽快行动，因为它们可能一夜之间就消失了。

sentences.en: And it's not just San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅仅是旧金山。

sentences.en: New York also went from having tens of thousands of signs in the 1970s
sentences.zh: 纽约也从20世纪70年代拥有数万个招牌，

sentences.en: to just a couple hundred today.
sentences.zh: 变成了今天仅剩几百个。

sentences.en: Hong Kong is losing a lot of its spectacular neon displays.
sentences.zh: 香港正在失去许多壮观的霓虹灯展示。

sentences.en: Signs change with their cities.
sentences.zh: 招牌随着城市而改变。

sentences.en: But in some spheres, neon is having a little revival.
sentences.zh: 但在某些领域，霓虹灯正在经历小小的复兴。

sentences.en: The few neon benders around are getting a lot of business
sentences.zh: 为数不多的霓虹灯弯制工正从

sentences.en: from high-end restaurants and hotels,
sentences.zh: 高端餐厅和酒店那里获得大量业务，

sentences.en: companies who want quotes illuminated on their walls,
sentences.zh: 那些想要在墙上点亮引语的公司，

sentences.en: or artists who are commissioning neon pieces.
sentences.zh: 或者委托制作霓虹灯艺术品的艺术家们。

sentences.en: Now, a custom neon sign represents an emphasis on craftsmanship and style,
sentences.zh: 现在，定制的霓虹灯招牌代表了对工艺和风格的强调，

sentences.en: tinged with a bit of nostalgia.
sentences.zh: 并带有一丝怀旧色彩。

sentences.en: And sure, this all sounds very artisanal and stuff,
sentences.zh: 当然，这一切听起来非常手工艺术之类的，

sentences.en: but this might just be the way the neon craft survives.
sentences.zh: 但这可能正是霓虹灯工艺得以生存的方式。

sentences.en: At its core, the ingredients are simple.
sentences.zh: 其核心成分很简单。

sentences.en: Glass, electricity, and gas from the air we breathe.
sentences.zh: 玻璃、电力，以及来自我们呼吸的空气中的气体。

sentences.en: And the results bend into something spectacular.
sentences.zh: 而结果却弯曲成了壮观的景象。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible was produced this week by Avery Truffleman,
sentences.zh: 本周的《99% Invisible》由Avery Truffleman制作，

sentences.en: with Katie Mingle, Sam Greenspan, Kurt Colstead, and me, Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 参与制作的还有Katie Mingle、Sam Greenspan、Kurt Colstead以及我，Roman Mars。

sentences.en: Special thanks this week to Jim Rizzo of Neon Works in Oakland,
sentences.zh: 本周特别感谢奥克兰Neon Works的Jim Rizzo，

sentences.en: and Tom Downs, author of Walking San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 以及《漫步旧金山》的作者Tom Downs。

sentences.en: Randall and Al's photography book,
sentences.zh: Randall和Al的摄影集，

sentences.en: San Francisco Neon Survivors and Lost Icons,
sentences.zh: 《旧金山霓虹：幸存者与失落的偶像》，

sentences.en: is now in its third printing.
sentences.zh: 现在已经第三次印刷了。

sentences.en: We are a project of 91.7 KALW San Francisco
sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山91.7 KALW的一个项目，

sentences.en: and produced out of the offices of ArcSign,
sentences.zh: 在ArcSign的办公室制作，

sentences.en: an architecture and interiors firm
sentences.zh: 这是一家建筑和室内设计公司，

sentences.en: in beautiful downtown Oakland, California.
sentences.zh: 位于美丽的加利福尼亚州奥克兰市中心。

sentences.en: You can find this show and like the show on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 你可以在Facebook上找到并关注这个节目。

sentences.en: We're all on Twitter, Tumblr, Instagram, and Spotify,
sentences.zh: 我们都在Twitter、Tumblr、Instagram和Spotify上，

sentences.en: but you can listen to every single episode of 99% Invisible
sentences.zh: 但你可以在99pi.org上收听《99% Invisible》的每一集。

sentences.en: at 99pi.org.
sentences.zh: 我们都在Twitter、Instagram、Instagram和Instagram上。

sentences.en: We're all on Twitter, Instagram, Instagram, and Instagram.
sentences.zh: 我们都在Twitter、Instagram、Instagram和Instagram上。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。
